text: This is Skywalker. A game engine built, from the ground up, for AI agents.
Here, you don't build alone. Meet your crew: a director, a level designer, a lighting artist, and a gameplay programmer. Each one is an AI agent.
The director took one idea, a cozy village floating in the sky, and split it into tasks.
Then the crew got to work. Together, at the same time, inside the live editor. Every change is real, attributed, and undoable.
Agents see the scene the way you do. Every object is labeled, so they know exactly what they are looking at.
Behaviors start as plain language. The crew weaves them into Wander, a safe, deterministic language, so the windmill turns, airships cruise, and fireflies drift.
Golden hour, or night. Lighting is one request away.
Two D? Same engine. Same agents. Sky Dash was built entirely through engine tools.
And when you want control, it's a real editor. Gizmos, properties, history, and a console. Humans and agents use the exact same tools.
Bring Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, or a model running on your own machine. Through MCP, any agent can drive the engine.
One person. A whole game. Skywalker.
